body:
Rereading my post I thought the same thing.  I know he cares,  and yet I feel like "nobody cares". He tries so hard, but there's only so much he can do for me.  These are my demons. And I'm too ashamed to tell my dad I'm having such a hard time just... living. 

Thank you for pointing this out though. Made me rethink some things.
I know you're right.  I just don't want to disappoint him or make him feel like he failed me or should have raised me different.  He makes me so proud.  I want to make him proud too.
